svg.title: The Pitch · 2026 commit season as a chalk cricket scorecard
svg.desc: A chalk cricket season on one board: scoreboard strip up top, season stat card on the left, date-driven wagon wheel over a mini pitch, the top-8 day table on the right and the full season week by week along the bottom. Scoreboard: 518 runs, 28 blank weeks, 52 overs, top day 84, 10 4s, 21 6s.
